item.text:
claim analyst-auditor-documents
  ∀x: analyst(x) ∧ audits(x, restricted-system) implies documents(x, restricted-system).

claim contractor-cannot-document-restricted
  ∀x: contractor(x) implies not documents(x, restricted-system).

observation contractor-audits-restricted
  ∃x: contractor(x) ∧ audits(x, restricted-system).

claim audited-contractor-is-not-analyst
  The existential contractor cannot be an analyst, because that would require both documenting and not documenting the restricted system.

link analyst-auditor-documents supports audited-contractor-is-not-analyst
link contractor-cannot-document-restricted supports audited-contractor-is-not-analyst
link contractor-audits-restricted supports audited-contractor-is-not-analyst

claim final-answer
  The answer is A.

link audited-contractor-is-not-analyst supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 measured
